notes.title: Small changes
notes.notes:
-Correction of lines in Brazilian Portuguese.
-Name correction in English and Brazilian Portuguese.

notes.title: BUG fixes
notes.notes:
-Images not appearing bug fixed.
-Buggy background screen colliding with others and appearing in different scenes fixed.
-Speech correction.

Note:

I sincerely apologize to everyone who experienced these errors and stopped experiencing the game in the normal way. The error came from a very up-to-date version of the “Renpy” tool, which is very well known for creating VN games, but unfortunately, very up-to-date versions end up leaving some bugs, but from now on, I will only use one version (which is the same one used for the first release version), and then ensure that this does not happen again.

Thank you for your understanding, and I hope from the bottom of my heart that you can enjoy/reuse the game.
